name: build-learning-track
title_zh: 从招聘启事反推学习路径，每步都标出处
tagline_zh: 把「想学 Java」变成能执行、能复习、能检验的路线图。不挑教材，从招聘启事、旧笔记或一个 URL 起步。
tagline_en: Turn 'learn Java' into a source-grounded roadmap with practice and recall cards. Works from job posts, notes.
desc_en: Build or revise a material-agnostic, source-grounded learning track from a goal, syllabus, job posting, existing notes, files, URLs, or a request such as learning Java, Rust, Go, Python, or another subject. Use when an agent must research or organize learning material, create executable practice, seed recall cards, or adapt scope to a learner's outcome and time budget.
why_zh: 它不生成泛泛大纲，而是把每个学习目标钉在具体来源上，再按你的时间预算裁剪范围，产物可直接执行。
why_en: No generic outlines: every milestone is anchored to a real source, scoped to your time budget, and ready to execute.
limit_zh: 只产出学习计划与卡片种子，不代你完成练习；需要你提供目标或素材，否则只能给通用模板。
limit_en: Outputs plans and card seeds only, not completed exercises. Needs a goal or source material; hands-on skills like debugging get thinner coverage.
title_en: Reverse-engineer a learning track from any goal or job post
